title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 68
description: Ten questions on Psalms 68: God arising and scattering his enemies, the father of the fatherless, the chariots of God, a procession into the sanctuary and kingdoms called to sing.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask to happen to God's enemies in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:1 says, "Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered!"

questions.text: To what is the perishing of the wicked compared in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:2 says, "As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God."

questions.text: God is called a father of whom in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:5 says God is a father of the fatherless and a defender of the widows.

questions.text: In what does God set the lonely, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:6 says, "God sets the lonely in families."

questions.text: At the presence of the God of which place did the sky pour down rain?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:8 says the sky poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai.

questions.text: Where did it snow when the Almighty scattered kings?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:14 says, "When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon."

questions.text: How does verse 17 describe the number of God's chariots?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:17 says the chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands.

answers.text: Tens of thousands and thousands of thousands

questions.text: With what were the ladies playing in the procession?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:25 says the singers went before and the minstrels after, among the ladies playing with tambourines.

questions.text: Which tribe is called "little" and "their ruler" in verse 27?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:27 says, "There is little Benjamin, their ruler."

questions.text: Out of which land shall princes come, according to verse 31?
questions.explanation: Psalms 68:31 says, "Princes shall come out of Egypt."
